settings.heading: Flooring Done Differently.
settings.content: Empowering you with a better way to purchase luxury flooring—without the luxury price tag.

settings.heading: Offering the Best Flooring Products at Competitive Prices.
Meet Flooret
settings.content: When we founded Flooret, we sought to break through the monopolization of flooring distributors, believing that quality construction and contemporary designs should be accessible to everyone, no matter their budget. That’s why we created a direct-to-consumer model that replaces the many layers and extreme mark-ups of standard distribution with an innovative approach that prioritizes what’s truly most important—your satisfaction.

settings.timeline_content: The parents of Tal Atid, co-founder of Flooret, open Tulip Hardwood Floors in the East Bay Area of Northern California.
Tal officially joins his parents’ flooring business and learns all the tricks of the trade.
A fortuitous meeting: Michael Maddux, another Flooret co-founder, enters the picture. He and Tal strike up a friendship that ultimately leads to the creation of Flooret.
Tal’s childhood friend, Devin Scott, and Michael’s colleague, Nathaneal Hartman, join the Flooret team as fellow co-founders.
Flooret officially opens for business! Our first venture: the extraordinary Modin Vinyl Plank Collection.
Expanding our scope: Flooret opens its second warehouse in Tennessee.
Another distinguished style joins the Flooret lookbook: Silvan Resilient Hardwood.
Flooret expands into Laminate with our Arista Collection.
Flooret celebrates 10 years helping our customers transform their spaces with durable, designer-curated floors.

settings.heading: Where We’ve Been, Where We’re Going
Going Above and Beyond
settings.content: Our commitment to thoughtful craftsmanship and exceptional customer experience drives us forward—and it hasn’t gone unnoticed. Since Flooret’s launch, our average company rating is 4.79—almost 85% of clients have awarded us 5 stars. Most importantly, we’re proud to have completed over 2,000 commercial projects and provided flooring solutions to over 45,000 homes.

settings.heading: Find Your Flooret.
settings.content: If Flooret’s mission speaks to you, why not trust us with your next project? The proof is in our purpose.
